blocks.content: Sports infrastructure and youth engagement have been an actively promoted policy area in recent years, partly framed by the government as part of a broader normalcy-and-development narrative for the UT.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Overview of policies and schemes driven towards Youth Development.
Promotion and infrastructure buildup for Winter Sports.
Development of key facilities for Cricket, Football, and other major sports disciplines.

Gulmarg (Chapter 24) is J&K's premier winter-sports hub, hosting skiing, snowboarding and other winter-sports competitions at both national and select international levels, supported by its high-altitude Gondola cable-car infrastructure.

The Winter Games Federation of India and various national ski-championship events have periodically been held at Gulmarg, reflecting its status as one of India's very few genuinely world-class winter-sports venues.

Sher-i-Kashmir International Cricket Stadium, Srinagar, is J&K's principal international-standard cricket venue, having hosted domestic first-class and List A matches, alongside occasional international/exhibition fixtures.

Football has a historically strong following in the Kashmir Valley in particular, with various grassroots and youth football initiatives (including government-supported tournaments) promoted as part of youth-engagement policy in recent years, alongside the broader Khelo India scheme's extension to the UT.

Khelo India infrastructure grants and youth-sports promotion schemes have been extended to J&K as part of the central government's national sports-development framework, with new stadiums and sports infrastructure development across several districts publicised as part of the UT administration's development agenda.
Key sports infrastructure locations and newly established stadiums across India are frequently asked.
Winter sports centers and national sports development schemes feature prominently in competitive exams.
Gulmarg = J&K's premier winter-sports hub, host to national/select international skiing and snowboarding events.
Sher-i-Kashmir International Cricket Stadium, Srinagar = J&K's principal international-standard cricket venue.
Khelo India scheme extended to J&K UT, supporting new sports infrastructure across districts.
